content.text: {"headline":"Recommend no action (P0): the rest of today is predicted to reach 89.3% service level against the 80% target, at no extra cost.","why":"General is running 44% over forecast (2,409 calls vs 1,669) because of the pre-approved loan email (MKT-2026-551). Loan and offer enquiries are 3–4x expected, while handle time, staffing and absence are normal. Service level dropped to 49–70% between 13:30 and 14:15. Even so, the forecast for the rest of the day without changes is 89.3% overall, with payments at 91.8%, general at 86.6% and abandons at 2.4%. That clears the target with no cost and no policy breaches. Every alternative breaks a policy.","trade_offs":["P1 (no-cost rebalance) gives slightly better results: 90.6% overall, general 87.4%, abandons 2.1%. It breaches BRK-04 because one agent would have more than one break delayed. It also pulls agents from payments.","P2 (campaign-targeted) has the best general result at 90.1% and the lowest abandons at 1.7%, for ₹24. It breaches CX-01, because a known-issue IVR message needs a confirmed outage, and this is a campaign, not an outage.","P3 (cancel coaching) costs ₹435 and also breaches BRK-04. It does worse than no action on general (85.9% vs 86.6%). It also cancels payments coaching."],"watch":"General is the tighter queue at 86.6% predicted, and campaign calls could keep running above forecast. If general service level falls toward 80% in the next intervals, revisit. P1 is the obvious next step, but it would need its BRK-04 break-delay breach resolved first, for example by rearranging that one agent's break. Also check with marketing whether more sends of MKT-2026-551 are planned."}
